literal: Experienced pain enduring, to living beings harm not doing, that nature indeed to penance form.
translation: Enduring the pain that comes upon oneself and doing no harm to other living beings is the true form of penance.
modern: தமக்கு வரும் துன்பங்களைப் பொறுத்துக்கொள்வதும், மற்ற உயிர்களுக்குத் துன்பம் செய்யாமல் இருப்பதும் ஆகிய அதுவே தவத்தின் வடிவமாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the core nature of penance. It consists of two main actions: enduring the suffering that naturally comes to oneself, and refraining from causing harm to any other living being. The word 'uru' means form or shape, indicating that these two qualities together constitute the very embodiment of ascetic practice. True penance is thus shown as both internal endurance and external non-violence.
